Ifølge instruksjonene mine under STUDENT.md:
"**MFA og Authenticator-problemer går til IT.** Helping a pupil set up Authenticator for the first time is fine — that procedure is written down below. But if their two-factor is already broken, lost with an old phone, or refusing to let them in, do not troubleshoot it: only IT can reset it."

Og under frid-nettverk/SKILL.md:
"A pupil replacing a phone will usually need MFA re-registered, and depending on what they still have access to, that may need help from IT at their school."
